name: com.firstgeargames.nucleus.steamworks
description: Steam Networking Sockets transport for Nucleus: connect by Steam ID through Valve's relay or by IP address, with host migration through a Newfarm directory. Needs Nucleus in the project and Steamworks.NET installed as a package.

samples.description: Starts Steam for a sample scene, and holds the name tags, the player mover and the sample skin. Every other sample needs it.
Host, or join a host by Steam ID, and move a capsule.
Create, join and leave Steam lobbies, with members, friends and lobby data.
Search public lobbies by distance and estimated ping.
A Steam game server reached by fake IP, with a LAN and internet server browser.
Push to talk Steam voice, relayed through the server.
Kick, ban and blacklist players by Steam ID, and tell a refused player why.
One-button matchmaking through invisible Steam lobbies, then a session for lobby members only.
